title: Visvesvaraya Plan Gandhian Plan FICCI Proposal Congress Plan Bombay Plan
definition: The pre-independence economic planning blueprints developed by Indian technocrats, industrialists, Gandhians, and political leaders between 1934 and 1944 to transition colonial India into a modern, self-reliant industrialized economy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims via chronological ordering, authorship matching, and ideological inclinations, and serves as foundational GS Mains content for tracing the evolution of Indian economic planning and state capitalism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, chronology, and authorships of the pre-independence economic plans.
Evaluate the ideological divide between heavy industrialization (Bombay Plan, Visvesvaraya) and decentralized agrarian/cottage development (Gandhian Plan).
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky chronological and matching-based Prelims questions.
prerequisites: Foundations of Indian Economy and Planning
